statement: Quant trading firms are becoming a meaningful CoreWeave customer segment, with the HRT deal stacking on Jane Street's $6 billion capacity commitment and a separate IMC expansion.
why: Demand for large GPU clusters is broadening beyond AI labs and hyperscalers into financial services buyers.

impact.mechanism: A widening buyer base reduces reliance on a few AI-lab customers and adds incremental cluster demand.

evidence.excerpt: on top of the $6 billion Jane Street commitment within a few months

confidence.basis: Company release plus press coverage summarized within the same document; single-source, secondary.
